label: WRITING
blurb: Write or rework a piece of prose: release notes, a README, a post.

stages.label: OUTLINE
stages.instructions: Say what the piece has to cover and in what order, before writing a sentence of it. Read whatever it is about — the diff, the code, the notes — so the outline is about the real thing.

stages.label: DRAFT
stages.instructions: Write it. Plain sentences, no throat-clearing, no adjectives doing work a verb should. Then list what you cut and why, so the trim is reviewable.

stages.label: REVISE
stages.instructions: Apply the notes exactly — do not take the opportunity to rewrite what wasn't questioned. Show the final text and what this pass changed.
